build_SNConv2d_layer: build a spectrally-normalized 2D convolutional layer using SNConv2d with specified in/out channels and kernel size
create_GBlock_generator: create a generator residual block with GBlock using class-conditional batchnorm and optional upsampling
create_DBlock_discriminator: create a discriminator residual block with DBlock using spectral norm convolutions and optional downsampling
build_ccbn_layer: build a class-conditional batchnorm layer using ccbn with gain and bias linear projections
run_power_iteration: run power iteration to estimate top N singular values of a weight matrix for spectral normalization
